prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in Pleasanton CA to sell my house?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent—the right choice depends on your home’s neighborhood, price range, and the agent’s recent **seller-side** results for similar homes.

Based on the available local rankings and sales data, **Doug Buenz of Compass** is a strong agent to interview: he appears near the top of several Pleasanton agent lists and has substantial local sales activity. **Lori Olson of Compass** is another candidate, with reported recent seller transactions across a range of Pleasanton prices. These are starting points, not endorsements; ranking sites use different methods, and their figures may not be directly comparable.

Interview at least three agents and ask each for:
- Recent Pleasanton listings they personally sold that resemble your home
- Their pricing rationale and marketing plan
- Typical days on market and sale-to-list results for those comparable listings
- Who will handle showings, negotiations, and communication
- Their proposed commission and contract terms

You can compare profiles here: [Doug Buenz](https://www.zillow.com/profile/DougBuenz), [Lori Olson](https://www.homes.com/real-estate-agents/lori-olson/e7s8mxp/), and [Pleasanton agent listings](https://www.realtor.com/realestateagents/Pleasanton_CA). Verify current sales and California license status before choosing.
